comment:
sorafenib: small-molecule RAF kinase inhibitor → chemical.
Ras_GTP / Ras_GDP: Ras bound to nucleotide; protein–ligand complexes composed of RAS family (HRAS/KRAS/NRAS) and GTP/GDP → complex.
Raf1 / pRaf1: RAF1 protein (phospho-state represented but base entity is RAF1) → protein.
Ras_Raf1 / Ras_pRaf1 / Ras_pRaf1_tetramer / Ras_pRaf1_Raf1_tetramer / Ras_BRaf_Raf1_tetramer / other Ras–Raf assemblies: multimeric complexes containing RAS (HRAS/KRAS/NRAS), nucleotide (GTP) and RAF family members (RAF1 and/or BRAF) → complex.
Ras_iRaf1 / iRaf1 / Ras_iRaf1_tetramer / nfpiRaf1 / nfpiBRaf / related nfpi / nfp species: species annotated as RAF1 or BRAF bound to sorafenib (and sometimes Ras+GTP) — treated as complexes including the protein(s) and sorafenib → complex (or protein+chemical where appropriate).
BRaf / nfpBRaf / BRaf_dimer: BRAF protein (dimeric states are complexes of BRAF) → protein or complex for dimer forms.
MEK / pMEK: MAP2K family (MEK1/2) proteins → protein.
ERK / pERK: MAPK family (ERK1/2) proteins → protein.
iBRaf / iBRaf_dimer / BRaf_iBRaf_dimer: BRAF bound to sorafenib (and dimers/heterodimers thereof) → complexes containing BRAF and sorafenib.
Ras_Raf1_iBRaf_tetramer / Ras_pRaf1_iBRaf_tetramer / Ras_Braf_iRaf1_tetramer / Ras_Braf_pRaf1_tetramer / Ras_Braf_iRaf1_tetramer / Ras_iRaf1_iBRaf1_tetramer / Ras_iRaf1_iBRaf1_tetramer etc.: higher-order assemblies formed in the model by pairing Ras–RAF protomers; all contain the constituent proteins (HRAS/KRAS/NRAS, RAF1, BRAF) and, where indicated, ligands (GTP, sorafenib) → complex.
mE / mEL / mELmEL / E / EG2 / EG2SOS: EGFR receptor states and EGFR complexes with EGF, GRB2 and/or SOS; EGFR is a protein (ERBB1) and EGF is a small peptide growth factor → proteins and receptor–ligand/protein complexes.
GRB2_SOS / GRB2 / SOS / nfpSOS: GRB2 and SOS proteins and their bound complex; nfpSOS denotes a modified (negative-feedback) form of SOS but maps to SOS1/SOS2 family → proteins or protein complexes as listed.
Where family tokens appear (RAS, SOS, MEK, ERK) they were expanded to canonical paralogs (HRAS/KRAS/NRAS; SOS1/SOS2; MAP2K1/MAP2K2; MAPK1/MAPK3) per instructions. Chemical ligands (GTP/GDP, EGF, sorafenib) are listed as chemical components in the complexes.
